summary: Missing hiker Kevin Rudnicki, last seen Sunday 2018-09-02 ~8:45 a.m. on the Mt. Herman Trail near Monument; ~60 rescue team members and civilian volunteers searched Tuesday 2018-09-04; Alpine Rescue Team paged 19:41 to assist El Paso County SAR.
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team (assist to El Paso County SAR); El Paso County SAR (lead); Douglas County SAR; Fremont County SAR
notes: Alpine mission 2018-101; date = Alpine mission/paged date and Gazette/AP search-operation date (2018-09-04, Tuesday-verified); hiker last seen Sunday 2018-09-02; outcome unreported (no resolution coverage found); fills thin year 2018 for El Paso. SARDOC 2018 public mission summaries entry dated 2018-09-05 (Monument, CO): search for a missing 20-y/o male, subject later found deceased — consistent same-incident reading with this search (multi-agency op 9/4 led by El Paso County SAR in the Monument area; SARDOC entry carries no name/agency attribution, so treated as corroboration only, not an outcome flip).
